scope: Recovery of the 22 TITLE functions that had no source (35,024 bytes). Lanes worked in private scratch inside their canonical units; the integrator installed results with in-place restaging. Masked equality is never FUNCTION_MATCH; size-exact RECONSTRUCTED rows enable natural placement but are not codegen equality.
tools: work/converge/titlelane.py (scratch unit copy and whole-unit check) and work/converge/integrate_title.py (install, in-place stage, RECONSTRUCTED rows with measured proofs); diagnostic helpers outside the gate.

causes: TitlePadMap.button must be short (unsigned short gives 7440 bytes).
The delay test is written as if (g_2a210 == 0) {...} else g_2a210--; which places the decrement at 0xb6cc.

The outer switch case order decides the join reload at 0xb440: equal exactly when case 0xffff precedes case 4 (30 placements measured, identical layout). This contradicts the SP3-derived 'case order is inert' rule for this RTM allocation decision.
tE u09a40.c.discriminator: A signed pressed local (cursor_5c) gives 16 bytes, so cursor_5c is read unsigned.

tD u09a40.c.cause: One effect: in the 999-loop calls to title_054f0 the original allocates the sound value first (movsx eax,[eax+T+2], reusing the dying index register) and the object pointer second (ecx); ours allocates the pointer first, the value lands in edx and later rotor choices shift. A diagnostic callee with swapped parameters leaves only the two swapped push pairs (4 bytes). The isolated loop also yields edx, so whole-function context (rotor across earlier-emitted cases) or IR argument order is involved.
inert: value or pointer locals (function/block scope, register, short)
